## OWNER #380 K2-G1 — HOSTED NATIVE OS AUTHORITY FEASIBILITY TEST-ONLY GO / PRODUCTION NO-GO (2026-10-13)

Follow-on to [K2 product security contract](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/issues/380#issuecomment-6139718764) and independently accepted [K2-T0 negative evidence](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/issues/380#issuecomment-6139390521). Owner authorizes **one tightly scoped Codex Cloud G1 test-only Draft PR**, with bounded genuine Windows/macOS Hosted OS capability checks and explicit released-binary provenance gate. This is NOT approval to change the actual application, run Owner-native machines, migrate a DB, or publish a release.

**Remote checked:** master `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97`. Existing `ci.yml` supports Windows and macOS Hosted jobs; `release-build.yml` requires exact-SHA Full Validation for installer packaging. The GitHub Releases collection returned **0 public releases** in the checked repository; this does not prove no binary is retained elsewhere. Historical PR #322 documents a *Windows installer artifact identity*, `Zen Canvas_0.1.40_x64-setup.exe`, 9,811,183 bytes, SHA-256 `02C9ECE0B6799947D8828E7BB0D0B9F52F95166DF3030FC2C503F1688EAD21F9`; the bytes/hosted accessibility have **not** been verified. Do not invent a matching installer, treat a rebuilt binary as shipped, or obtain it from untrusted mirrors. #389/#390 remain OPEN/Draft, master unchanged.

**Single PR:** proposed branch `test/issue-380-k2-g1-platform-authority`, Draft title `test(global-index): #380 K2-G1 hosted OS authority feasibility`. Allowed files only:
- `tests/issue380_k2_g1/**` for disposable native actor/harness/structured evidence;
- `docs/research/ISSUE-380-K2-G1-PLATFORM-AUTHORITY.md`;
- **exception for this research only**, one entirely NEW `.github/workflows/issue380-k2-g1-native.yml` if required to execute bounded native Windows/macOS test-only jobs through a normal PR event. Workflow must be `pull_request` scoped to the G1 paths, `permissions: contents: read`, hard timeouts, no secrets/privilege, no `pull_request_target`, no full-CI dispatch. Do NOT edit existing workflows, CI gates, validation plan, branch protection, Schema, product modules, Service, NSIS or installer. If native job cannot safely run on a Draft PR under these rules, mark unavailable rather than weakening them.

**Mandatory G1-01..08**: (01) immutable old-image provenance/actual SHA and availability, (02) real Windows held SQLite WAL writer vs `CreateFileW` sharing/exclusive-handle/open-failure, (03) guarantee-compatible WAL-complete final backup *while any claimed barrier remains held*; (04) main/WAL/SHM alias and physical identity including symlink/hardlink/reparse where feasible; (05) genuine bounded child exit/relaunch/copied actor and explicitly UNVERIFIED real cross-session/SCM/NSIS; (06) native macOS POSIX handle/flock/late writer test—not Linux proxies; (07) last old acknowledged commit vs snapshot/new first acknowledged write, recovery and no-silent-fork; (08) source-bound installation/DB generation/C2/#381 dependency trace, without full audit or modification. A mechanism that prevents *our own* final backup or allows late old commits is NOT a GO design. Use only disposable per-run roots, small fixtures and strict process/path ownership; no real user data, service install/stop, OS permission mutation outside fixture, app autoindex, registry modification, power-cycle or install of untrusted old product binaries.

**Evidence levels must separate:** pinned source findings, actual Hosted-Windows API/process/SQLite effects, actual Hosted-macOS effects, actual shipped old Zen Canvas executable proof (if obtainable, exact hash/isolated execution only), reconstructed old-source build, and Owner-native NOT_RUN. If no authentic old binary is available, native OS capability can be researched but **actual shipped-version upgrade safety remains UNVERIFIED**. Natural existing PR CI is not the G1 native proof and green CI does not imply production GO. Author-reported local logs remain separate from committed hash-bound inputs/actual final-head hosted evidence.

**Terminal:** `K2_G1_HOSTED_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW`, `K2_G1_PLATFORM_EVIDENCE_PARTIAL`, `K2_G1_PLATFORM_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED`, or `K2_G1_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE`. Preserve negative controls and OS error codes. Stop at Draft PR for independent Owner review; no self-merge, Review bot, Issue close, v38, #381 production work, Full Validation/100k/500k/1m, Owner Windows native work, release or production remediation.

**GO/NO-GO:** `K2_G1_TEST_ONLY_EXECUTION_GO / SHIPPED_OLD_BINARY_AVAILABILITY_UNVERIFIED / WINDOWS_MACOS_LIFETIME_AUTHORITY_UNPROVEN / K2_HYBRID_PRODUCTION_NO_GO / #380_PRODUCTION_NO_GO / #381_HOLD / SCHEMA_V38_UNALLOCATED / NSIS_U2_RELEASE_NO_GO / EXISTING_DRAFT_MERGE_HOLDS_UNCHANGED`.

Full standalone Owner contract delivered in conversation as `Zen_Canvas_380_K2_G1_Native_Authority_Feasibility_2026-10-13.md` (not committed to GitHub).

product_contract.body:
## OWNER #380 K2 — PRODUCT UPGRADE SECURITY BOUNDARY FROZEN FOR DESIGN / AUTOMATIC MIGRATION NO-GO (2026-10-13)

**Owner architecture decision after independently accepted K2-T0 failure evidence:** [PR #390](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/390) / [Owner acceptance](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/issues/380#issuecomment-6139390521). This is a **product support/security contract**, NOT a production implementation, OS enforcement certification or release decision. A standalone complete Markdown Owner report named `Zen_Canvas_380_K2_Owner_Product_Upgrade_Safety_Boundary_Decision_2026-10-13.md` was delivered in the Owner conversation, **not** committed to GitHub.

**Checked remote:** master remains `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97` tree `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`; #380/#381 OPEN; PR #390 `e1e993893a87aa916c67f7cff41a102b269fcf88` OPEN/Draft; #389 `bbdd3db254582ae622236237b87adb73b097bc42` OPEN/Draft. Previous #385/#386/#388 holds unchanged. This Owner step made no code, CI or PR changes.

### Product boundary — accepted for design

1. **Support a managed maintenance cutover, not omnipotent whole-machine exclusion**: Zen Canvas must protect its **own DB truth, acknowledged metadata/corrections/history, journaled product operations**, and pre-action file identity checks. The product must NOT promise that installing a new version can globally deprive **any** unmodified same-user binary, third-party app or separate old copied executable of its OS permission to operate on the user's personal files.
2. **Do not dilute the database safety invariant**: if continuous quiescence/exclusion of **all released old Zen Canvas DB writers** (retained SQLite handles, late relaunch, standalone Desktop/Direct/Worker, Service/IPC, copied binary and alias paths) across final old commit -> WAL-complete snapshot -> activation/first new write **cannot be proved**, automatic DB-generation migration must **BLOCK BEFORE FIRST TARGET DB OPEN/MIGRATE/MUTATION**. An installer process check, SCM STOPPED, new-only mutex, a DB filename change, SQLite BUSY or a user consent click does NOT discharge this condition.
3. **Candidate H only**: trusted maintenance/exclusion window + complete SQLite snapshot/physical DB/WAL/SHM identity + verified offline migration/user-state preservation + crash-recoverable activation + new-generation mandatory preopen and per-write admission. S-only and N-only remain independently NO-GO. Since the native OS lifetime guarantee is unproved on Windows and macOS, H still has **PRODUCTION NO-GO**.
4. **Fail closed with recovery**: no migration or silent fork when the old writer identity/liveness is uncertain; if new generation accepted any user write, do NOT silently promote old Schema37 data as rollback. Ambiguous ledger, restored profile or post-activation old branch => `RECOVERY_REQUIRED` and controlled forward recovery/explicit no-loss assessment. User acknowledgement cannot override an unsafe automatic migration.
5. **Three version domains stay distinct**: installation activation, physical DB/write owner generation, and C2/#381 domain publication/Root+Source seal epochs. Preexisting #381 D4-S8R inventory and K0/K1/Track A/B evidence remain frozen; do not restart broad audit.
6. **Deployment lanes**: (A) preserve existing users and freeze cross-generation automatic DB migration until qualified; (B) cooperative preopen/epoch protocol may help **future** builds but cannot retroactively fence existing old binaries; (C) privileged broker/OS permission broker is an expensive alternative requiring a fresh Owner product/security decision, not a default dependency.

### Platform capability assessment (NOT an implementation selection)

- Source fact: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:135-150` resolves fixed `zen-canvas.sqlite3`; `db/connection.rs:79-100` opens pool/migrates pre-return; `main.rs:104-110` initializes DB before further runtime; `windows/installer-lifecycle-final.nsh:38-132` performs one-time Service stop/desktop name check and Preview quiesce; `windows/service_host.rs:1-15` mostly IPC/enumeration, not the Desktop SQLite sink.
- Windows: Microsoft's [CreateFile](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/fileapi/nf-fileapi-createfilea) sharing modes can prevent conflicting *new* opens under established conditions, but an existing SQLite WAL writer, current handles, path aliases and safe backup coexistence need **actual Windows native experiments**. [LockFileEx](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/fileapi/nf-fileapi-lockfileex) byte-range locks do not universally cover mapped views and all user files. Do not treat either mechanism as certified old-binary fencing.
- macOS: App Sandbox and security-scoped access entitlements are [process-scoped access mechanisms](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/accessing-files-from-the-macos-app-sandbox), **not** a general power to withdraw an existing same-user unsandboxed program's rights. Tauri LaunchAgent/single-instance/new-only flock not a preexisting old-app fence.
- SQLite [Online Backup API](https://sqlite.org/backup.html) supplies a consistent snapshot, **not** the last-possible-old-commit exclusion proof.

### Next bounded evidence gate — proposed, NOT automatically started

The **only meaningful next research** is genuine Windows/macOS native OS capability and *shipped old-binary* behavior, not another Linux Python-actor negative harness. Proposed label `K2-G1_PLATFORM_AUTHORITY_FEASIBILITY`: clean disposable Hosted Windows/macOS if actually available, no user machine nor real service, real old product binary SHA/signature/version, actual SQLite WAL/SHM/file identity and API return codes, old connection/relaunch/aliases/session/cutover, measured incomplete coverage. If a suitable native environment or old binary is unavailable, deliver `PLATFORM_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE` / `BLOCKED` instead of green mocks. Native Owner machine remains acceptance-only and requires explicit separate approval. Scope and further Codex execution authorization must be separately written before any new PR.

**CURRENT FREEZE:** `K2_PRODUCT_UPGRADE_BOUNDARY_ACCEPTED_FOR_DESIGN / K2_OS_LIFETIME_EXCLUSION_UNPROVEN / K2_G1_NOT_STARTED / #380_PRODUCTION_NO_GO / #381_PRODUCTION_HOLD / SCHEMA_V38_UNALLOCATED / NSIS_U2_RELEASE_NO_GO / #385_#388_#389_#390_DRAFT_HOLD / #386_INDEPENDENT_MERGE_NO_GO`.

No new PR, CI dispatch, native testing, production modification, master mutation, Codex Review, merge, issue close or release in this Owner step.

## OWNER #380 K2-T0 — TEST-ONLY NEGATIVE EVIDENCE ACCEPTED / OS AUTHORITY BLOCKED / PRODUCTION NO-GO (2026-10-13)

Independent remote review completed for [Draft PR #390](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/390): read the complete report; `test_feasibility.py`, `actor.py`, `build_reused_probe.py`, `schema.sql`, `run.py`, targeted reports and structured event evidence; checked GitHub commit/tree/diff/scope, CI job conclusions and source checkout evidence. **This is review of committed source and recorded test results, not a new independent harness execution or native OS qualification.**

**Exact remote identity:** branch `test/issue-380-k2-t0-activation-feasibility`, HEAD `e1e993893a87aa916c67f7cff41a102b269fcf88`, tree `c432f0738f5c846fc98fd31c0e76305c2ee6a586`, sole parent/current master `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97`, master tree `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`. 1 ahead, 0 behind; **20 added files, +7850/-0**, confined to `tests/issue380_k2_activation/**` and `docs/research/ISSUE-380-K2-T0-ACTIVATION-FEASIBILITY.md`. PR OPEN/Draft, no production/Schema/IPC/NSIS/Service/workflow/CI/#381 changes or master mutation.

**Exact-head CI:** [run 38353559314](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38353559314), attempt 1 **SUCCESS**; independently checked **27 jobs: 7 SUCCESS / 20 conditional SKIPPED / 0 failed / 0 cancelled**. The validation-plan job reports `tree_equivalent=true`, `head_validation_required=false`, both HEAD/integration tree `c432f0738f5c846fc98fd31c0e76305c2ee6a586`. This CI does not run the K2-T0 harness and does not prove hosted Windows or macOS native exclusion.

**Bounded isolated executed evidence:** committed `unittest.stdout.txt` records **8/8 new tests OK in 2.152 seconds**. `results.json` has **338 actor/source/SQL events** and `methods_run=8,success=true`, pinned Python 3.12/SQLite 3.53.1/Linux x86_64/uid 1000. Frozen #389 K1 Rust probe shell extracted by Git hash and rebuilt against unchanged production `Database::open`/migrate and old/new fallback code; K1's 20 tests/Track A/B/#381 broad audit were **not rerun**.

T0-01: unchanged noncooperating Python legacy actor commits across before-admission, synthetic isolation, snapshot, new activation and reconnect: **5 persisted commits**, new snapshot lacks late old commits. T0-02: Service STOPPED and Desktop exit are modeled, while a separate surviving worker **actually writes**. T0-03: POSIX path symlink/normalization and main inode/WAL/SHM alias risks; hardlink to main inode with separate WAL filename reads old `USER_SEED` rather than canonical WAL commit; DELETE-mode replacement of a live DB path returned a real `SQLITE_READONLY_DBMOVED` on an existing connection (limited positive), but legacy reconnect wrote the replacement. T0-04: actual independent late/copy actors write; same uid can restore a file mode and reconnect; login-item/second-instance are role models, not product plugin tests. T0-05: backup after last **observed**, not last possible, commit loses an accepted late correction; old/new separate writes produce **no-silent-fork violation** in success and post-switch process-exit cases; SQL transform and pointer crash results are fixture-only, not production migration or power loss. T0-06: during real SQLite `BUSY` lock, actor still renames/moves/deletes disposable file and writes through retained unlinked fd. T0-07: missing/corrupt/mismatched experimental activation records do not stop frozen opener migration; old Unknown and D1-A new NotSent Direct routes both open DB in isolated shell; QA/restore path conditions not native tested. T0-08: read-only link to frozen C2/#381/metadata/FTS obligations, no new inventory.

**Provenance/qualification constraints:** committed `results.json.environment.head` is **the frozen master SHA** (precommit evidence); test input hashes bind the test code, but the author's final PR-HEAD local rerun outputs remain **uncommitted ignored artifacts**. Do not claim independently rerun exact-head K2 tests. Legacy actors are **Python behavioral substitutes**, not shipped old Zen Canvas binaries. Exposed duplicate `O_RDONLY` fd is not SQLite's hidden internal fd. POSIX `flock`/`chmod`/inode/rename and synthetic NSIS/SCM/second-instance events do NOT qualify Windows SCM/ACL/UAC/installer, macOS LaunchAgent/TCC/APFS, genuine power loss or user-machine native operation. All native gates `NOT_RUN/NATIVE_UNVERIFIED`. Test success is **successful reproduction of counterexamples**, not safe isolation.

**Owner decision:** **K2-T0 negative evidence is ACCEPTED**, but `K2_T0_OS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED` is the technical result. S-only current one-time stop/new-only lock **NO-GO**; N-only path/snapshot/pointer **NO-GO**; H Hybrid remains a **conditional architecture candidate / production NO-GO**, because continuous authoritative pre-open and runtime exclusion of noncooperating old writer/late launch/native file actor, last-old-write boundary, physical WAL/SHM namespace, durable activation/forward recovery remain unproved. No claim that a properly privileged native OS lifetime stop-world is mathematically impossible; it simply does not exist as established authority in present product/evidence. Equally, preventing an arbitrary old same-user process from operating on all personal files is not a promise a new-only DB mechanism can deliver.

**Next OWNER-ONLY product/architecture choice — not another automatically authorized Codex implementation:** narrow and define the supported upgrade security contract (controlled old Zen Canvas process quiescence with hard fail/block when unverifiable, no automatic cutover under mixed/unknown generations; distinguish protection of application's DB from all arbitrary user-file operations) versus an explicitly privileged externally enforced broker/OS-access architecture with user-visible installation/permission costs. Before choosing new validation/production work, define actual deployment trust boundary and native Windows/macOS feasibility; do NOT initiate K2-T1, full tests, v38, #381 production, native qualification or installer revision by implication.

**Status freeze:** `#380_K2_T0_TEST_ONLY_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED / K2_T0_OS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED / H_PRODUCTION_NO_GO / PR_390_OPEN_DRAFT_MERGE_HOLD / PR_389_OPEN_DRAFT_MERGE_HOLD / #385_MERGE_HOLD / #386_INDEPENDENT_MERGE_NO_GO / #388_MERGE_HOLD / #381_PRODUCTION_HOLD / SCHEMA_V38_UNALLOCATED / NSIS_U2_RELEASE_NO_GO`.
